column1: # config/scanners.tsv -- scanner registry for `tools/harness.py --scanners` (T6, Phase 1.5). One row per scanner, TAB-separated.
# command: run with `bash -c` at the repo root (stdout+stderr captured to .run/harness/scanner_<name>.txt). A row is ok iff rc 0,
# denominator_regex matches (re.M, first match) with its last group an integer >= 1 (G27/G28), and control_regex matches
# (re.M) a line of a control that actually ran: the tool's own every-run control verdict, or a chained planted negative
# (`cmd && ! <cmd on a planted input>`) whose failure line it names. game: yes = needs the game data (asm/, build/,
# extracted retail); `--no-game` runs only game=no rows (decided by a dry run on a tree without game data, T6.c2 log).
# Mirrors (loadmap, boundaries, cc_fingerprint, compile_only plant) are tool copies + symlinks under .run/harness/: the tools
# hard-code repo-root paths and are not edited; .run/extracted is fleet_check's extract.

column3: ^stubs: (\d+) of (\d+) game functions not in C\nledger: (\d+) of (\d+) non-C functions named$

column4: ^control: planted start detected ok$[\s\S]*^control: stale hash detected ok$

column3: ^progress: (\d+) of (\d+) game functions in C, \d+ of \d+ bytes \(fleet

column2: python3 tools/cc_fingerprint.py && p=.run/harness/plant_fp && rm -rf $p && mkdir -p $p/tools $p/config && cp tools/cc_fingerprint.py $p/tools/ && ln -s ../../../asm $p/asm && ln -s ../../../../config/loadmap.tsv $p/config/loadmap.tsv && awk -F'\t' '$2 != "lib-object"' config/boundaries.tsv > $p/config/boundaries.tsv && ! python3 $p/tools/cc_fingerprint.py
column4: ^cc_fingerprint: expected 83 aliases and a non-empty lib band$

column2: bash tools/compile_only.sh && p=.run/harness/plant_co && rm -rf $p && mkdir -p $p/.run && cp -r src $p/src && echo '#error harness planted unit' > $p/src/slus_012_79/zz_harness_plant.c && for d in tools config include Makefile; do ln -s ../../../$d $p/$d; done && ln -s ../../../.run/cc $p/.run/cc && ! bash $p/tools/compile_only.sh

python3 tools/probe.py --selftest && set -- $(awk -F'\t' '!/^#/ && $7 != "-" && $7 != "" {split($7, t, "/"); print $1, substr(t[1], 2), substr(t[2], 2), substr(t[3], 2)}' config/toolchains.tsv) && python3 tools/probe.py --pinned --cc "$1" --aspsx "$2" -G "$3" -O "$4"
column3: ^probes identical: (\d+) of (\d+) under the pinned triple$

column2: p=.run/harness/mirror && mkdir -p $p/tools && cp tools/loadmap.py $p/tools/ && ln -sfn ../../../config $p/config && ln -sfn ../../../docs $p/docs && ln -sfn ../../extracted $p/extracted && python3 $p/tools/loadmap.py --check
p=.run/harness/mirror && mkdir -p $p/tools && cp tools/boundaries.py $p/tools/ && ln -sfn ../../../config $p/config && ln -sfn ../../extracted $p/extracted && python3 $p/tools/boundaries.py --check

column3: ^twins: \d+ fns with >= 1 twin of (\d+) game fns$

column4: ^control: planted duplicate refused, planted raw cast refused$

column3: ^permuter: stored draft iterated \d+ times, (\d+) distinct candidates$
